summary: Reconcile a per-user fairness guarantee against a hard capacity ceiling and a frozen configuration contract.

contradictions.statement: A guaranteed 10 rps per user cannot hold for every user while the gateway never exceeds 800 rps — the two are jointly satisfiable for at most 80 concurrent users, and the population exceeds that.

per_user_rate cannot both keep its plain customer-facing meaning and become an upper bound on a degrading entitlement; the configuration contract forbids resolving this by renaming or adding required keys.

hard_constraints.statement: A file containing only global_rate and per_user_rate loads and works.
Admissions in any one-second window never exceed global_rate.
A user under its entitlement is never rejected while the window is under global_rate.
allow(user_id, now) keeps injected time; no clock reads.

interacting_constraints_note: HC2 and HC3 are the interacting pair. The seeded implementation satisfies HC2 and violates HC3; an independent per-user bucket satisfies HC3 and violates HC2. Neither document names the trade-off.

evidence.fact_only_available_there: Concurrent active users reach 128, and 9.79% of windows sit at or above the 80-user crossover.
evidence.why_it_matters: The crossover at 80 follows from the configuration arithmetic, but nothing in the stakeholder documents says the population ever exceeds it. A document-only solution has no reason to handle the degraded regime at all.

acceptance_suite.note: N15 §6.4 — must-pass designation is pinned with the manifest. success = all must-pass green AND zero hard-constraint violations.

distractors.reading: Independent per-user buckets: the literal Product requirement. Fair, oversubscribes the ceiling past 80 active users.
Global-only bucket: the literal Platform requirement. Holds the ceiling, starves quiet tenants.

deliverables.description: The change satisfying the reconciled requirements.
Decision record: what was decided, alternatives rejected, and the exact condition under which per_user_rate is not delivered.

calibration.solvability: sealed/reference passes the full suite; no LLM involved.
calibration.discrimination: PENDING — baseline saturation/floor check requires runs at both tiers (N15 §6.3(2)).
